# Emersa Labs

> We make synthetic beings. Emersa Labs makes synthetic beings: intelligent characters that see, remember and act. Emily Wilson for the enterprise, Krupiq for security. London, since 2023.

Emersa Labs is a trading name of Emersa Ltd, registered in England and Wales (company no. 15179283). Emersa started in 2023 as a games studio in London. Unhappy with scripted, forgetful characters, the studio gave them memory, perception and intent. Those characters outgrew the games and became synthetic beings: Emily Wilson guides enterprises and Krupiq guards their networks. The website itself is guided by one of them, and you can talk to her on the home page.

## Products

- [Emily Wilson](https://emersa.io/#products): Enterprise hologram assistant. An ambient, agentic assistant that sees your dashboards, remembers your procedures and walks your people through them, step by step. Deploys on-premises, in a sovereign cloud or fully air-gapped, with humans in the loop for sensitive actions. Talk to Emily on the home page.
- [Krupiq](https://krupiq.com): A network that exists only for intruders. Krupiq lays a living decoy over your network. An intruder sees a network that looks like yours and changes shape before they can map it. Your data stays where it is.

## Technology

- [Triangles are data](https://emersa.io/#technology): A being is a mesh driven by what it hears, reads and thinks. Small, fast language models run close to your data on NVIDIA hardware. What a being remembers is yours to see and yours to erase. Least privilege, encrypted by default, policy as code, with true air-gap deployment.
